message: ただいま失踪中

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, morning, Sacchin. You're here early today.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mornin'~ Mind if I come in for a bit~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~? Nana-chan's shoes aren't here~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka hasn't come over.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No way~ It's no use hiding her~ I'm gonna do an inspection~!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~? She's not here~」

name: Sally
message: 「Sacchin, mornin'!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sally-chan! You ate my share of the soba too, didn't you~! That's so mean~」

name: Sally
message: 「Soba?! Where?! Feed me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin... I honestly have no idea what you've been making such a fuss about.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's no use trying to hide it, Synn-kun~ I already know Nana-chan came over here to make soba noodles~」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you say you 'already know,' Nanaka hasn't come here.」

name: Sally
message: 「If you mean Nanaka, she hasn't come over.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's got the little missy all worked up anyway?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ufufu, I figured it out~ You two skipped a few steps on the stairway to adulthood, didn't you~」

name: Synn
message: 「You're making even less sense than usual today, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huhhh~? There's no disheveled Nana-chan peeking out with naughty bits showing~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you even saying!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She really didn't come over~?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what I've been saying this whole time!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's weird~ I was sure she came over to make soba and changed plans to a morning roll in the hay~」

name: Synn
message: 「Please, Sacchin... if you can, explain things in order.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if she explains it in order, you probably still won't get it.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Um, well-- When I woke up in the morning, Nana-chan was gone--」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, so in other words, Nanaka stayed over at your place, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yup--」

name: Synn
message: 「Like last time, for the Sweets Club?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope-- It was after special training ended--」

name: Synn
message: 「Special training?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Awawawa. Whatever could you mean-- Oh right, Nana-chan suddenly said she was coming over to my place--」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of special training?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I told her she's welcome anytime so sure--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, about the special--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「By the way, my bed is super huge, you know-- Like, big enough to fit a truck--?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, we slept together-- We were chatting until we fell asleep, and Nana-chan looked like she wanted to keep talking, but--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan's been lacking sleep lately, so we wrapped that up early too, before 11 o'clock--」

name: Synn
message: 「Then she actually got some proper sleep yesterday.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She did-- But when I woke up in the morning, Nana-chan wasn't next to me, so I figured Nana-chan woke up early, snuck out of my house, and--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Maybe she was making soba over at your house, Synn-kun, or something--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I came over hoping to get in on some, too, but Nana-chan wasn't in the kitchen--」

name: Paqy
message: 「If she were the type who could pull that off, things wouldn't have turned out like this.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「True--」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Sacchin, you thought Nanaka left your place first and came here, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yup-- Great deduction--」
Yet Nanaka isn't here. Where did she go?

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka isn't coming...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wonder what she's doing~」

name: Eddie
message: 「If you're talking about Yuugiri, I saw her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where?!」

name: Eddie
message: 「About thirty minutes ago, when I was jogging around the new school building for morning practice, she came bolting inside at full speed.」

name: Synn
message: 「How did she look?」

name: Eddie
message: 「She was running while hiding her face with her bag. Looked like she was trying to avoid being seen.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If she had to go that badly, she could've just used the bathroom at my place~ What a weirdo, Nana-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Who says it was the bathroom...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, she was running, right~? I get it now~ She went to Synn-kun's place, suddenly needed the bathroom, and ran all the way to the academy~」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a huge stretch! If that were the case, she could've just used the one at Synn-sama's house!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You just don't understand a maiden's heart, Paqy-kun~ She wouldn't want Synn-kun to hear~ Plus the walls look pretty thin~」

name: Synn
message: 「Homeroom's about to start...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up? You're looking at me like I'm a missing person who just turned up after thirty-nine years.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is something weird? Nothing's weird, right?」
She looked sleep-deprived as usual, but aside from that, there wasn't anything particularly strange about her.

name: Synn
message: 「What were you doing?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, what was I doing? I literally just got here.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't go telling lies~ Even though you ran off all by yourself earlier~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uhh, well, that's... For once, I just kind of felt like breathing in the morning air all by myself, or something like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then I was strolling along slowly down roads I don't usually take, and ended up running late.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Yeah, things like that happen.」
Things like that do happen.
Still, was that really the truth?

name: Eddie
message: 「Hey, did you forget?! I told you thirty minutes ago that I saw it!」
Preparations for the Holy Night Festival. That's certainly part of it.
Still, is that really all there is to it?

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's Eddie we're talking about! You can't take his word for it.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh, yeah, true~」

name: Eddie
message: 「That's harsh! Hey Synn, you believe I'm not lying, right?」
Sacchin said she went to bed early yesterday.
Even so, she looks sleep-deprived.
Could Nanaka's lack of sleep not just be from not getting enough hours, but because she can't sleep?
Or does sleep deprivation not go away even after sleeping properly for just one day?

name: Eddie
message: 「Believe me, man!」
Nanaka is definitely lying.
But Nanaka told me, 'Don't ask anything until the Holy Night Festival is over.'
Once the Holy Night Festival is over, you'll tell me, right?
